| `MemoryAgentBench` | https://github.com/HUST-AI-HYZ/MemoryAgentBench |
| `MemoryOS` | https://github.com/BAI-LAB/MemoryOS |
| `a-mem` | https://github.com/agiresearch/a-mem |
| `lightmem` | https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem |
| `memrl` | https://github.com/MemTensor/MemRL |
| `memt` | https://github.com/yanweiyue/Mem-T |
| `plugmem` | https://github.com/TIMAN-group/PlugMem |
